test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Strong hostility
solution:
The correct answer is **'Animosity'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Animosity'.
 
• It means 'a strong feeling of dislike and hatred'. (अरुचि और घृणा की तीव्र भावना)
 
 
• *Example: The boss has personal **animosity ***towards Akash*.​*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Animalistic:** characteristics of animals, particularly in being physical and instinctive. (पाशविक; जानवरों की विशेषताएं, विशेष रूप से शारीरिक और सहज होने में)
 
• **Anonymity: **being private or anonymous. (गुमनामी)
 
• **Comity:** courtesy and considerate behavior towards other. (शिष्टाचार)
